admission.justification: The link component, viewer opener and confined server resolver together ensure that repository links reach the intended existing file and local heading.

applicability: Links in repository Markdown rendered by the File Viewer document context.
conditions: A repository file link becomes opening UI only after resolution confirms an existing file.
A fragment-only link resolves inside its own rendered document container.
Outside HTTP or HTTPS hyperlinks open a separate browser tab.
exclusions: Generic dashboard Markdown without a repository document context.
Using media fetch admission as the hyperlink protocol policy.

evidence: producer-proof-locators.json: BUG-R05@v1 §8; dashboard/src/grammar/DocumentMarkdown.test.tsx :: opens a repository file that exists, with its anchor; dashboard/src/grammar/DocumentMarkdown.test.tsx :: opens a code file link in the same viewer; dashboard/src/grammar/DocumentMarkdown.test.tsx :: opens a picture link in the same viewer; dashboard/src/grammar/DocumentMarkdown.test.tsx :: states a path the repository does not hold instead of linking it; dashboard/src/grammar/DocumentMarkdown.test.tsx :: opens an outside https address in a new tab; dashboard/src/grammar/DocumentMarkdown.test.tsx :: scopes an anchor click to its own rendered document; dashboard/src/grammar/DocumentMarkdown.test.tsx :: scrolls to a heading in the document
